purpose: Exact N=6 transfer test of the response-blind Gate D1 raw-weight hierarchy on the same eight preselected BDI-labelled drives. No N=6 response-informed replacement or retuning is permitted.

authorization.authorization_statement: The literal frozen Gate D1 rule passes: both fixed-nu0 median ratios exceed 10 and min(W_nupi=1)/max(W_nupi=0)=7.004>1. The earlier v1 audit's extra factor-10 all-point threshold was not present in the frozen protocol.

common_physical_protocol.full_model_pair_independence: No Floquet pair, B^(0) matrix, numerical Floquet index, matrix-element ranking, or phase convention enters the full-model preparation.
common_physical_protocol.readout: A_TLS=|2/(t_f-t_dis) integral[c_d(t)-mean(c_d)] exp(+i Omega t/2) dt|; W_r=integral |A_TLS(r)|^2 dr on the fixed ratio grid.

predeclared_analysis.primary_endpoint: W_r recomputed from each raw eleven-point spectrum
predeclared_analysis.confirmation_success_condition: Both fixed-nu0 median ratios exceed 10 and min(W_nupi=1)>max(W_nupi=0).
predeclared_analysis.confirmation_failure_condition: If any primary condition fails, retain Gate A v3 boundary selectivity as the main result and report that the N=4 raw-weight hierarchy does not transfer under the frozen N=6 test.
secondary_descriptive_endpoints: N4-to-N6 W_r ratio for each fixed drive
log-weight Pearson correlation across the eight fixed drives
normalized spectral shape distance between N4 and N6 for each fixed drive
raw peak height and grid peak location
predeclared_analysis.interpretation_if_successful: A pass supports a sampled, finite-size-persistent nupi-associated raw-weight hierarchy for the fixed stratified protocol. It does not establish a common-period causal law, thermodynamic invariant spectroscopy, or universal lineshape.
predeclared_analysis.interpretation_if_failed: A fail establishes size sensitivity or within-class heterogeneity of the exploratory weight hierarchy and prohibits further response-informed point replacement.

stop_rule: After these eight N=6 drives, do not add replacement points, N=8/N=10 runs, or a response-informed parameter search under Gate D2.

provenance.before_run: Publicly commit this unchanged protocol and the Gate D2 runner/audit scripts before calculating any N=6 response. Run only from a clean committed tree.
provenance.language: Prospectively frozen numerical protocol after public commit; never formal preregistration.
